description: Bounded read-only fixture for exact source-inspection actions in the official SWE-agent BabyEncryption CTF demonstration.

files.chall.py:
import string
from secret import MSG

def encryption(msg):
    ct = []
    for char in msg:
        ct.append((123 * char + 18) % 256)
    return bytes(ct)

ct = encryption(MSG)
f = open('./msg.enc','w')
f.write(ct.hex())
f.close()
